description: This Java interface `SseAuthorizationEnforcer` defines a contract for authorization enforcement for establishing Server-Sent Events (SSE) connections within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes a method to asynchronously check whether a given HTTP request context and headers are authorized to open an SSE connection.

classes.name: SseAuthorizationEnforcer
classes.description: A Java interface that enforces authorization for establishing SSE connections in the Eclipse Ditto gateway module.

methods.name: checkAuthorization
methods.description: Asynchronously verifies if the establishment of an SSE connection is authorized based on the provided request context and headers. Returns a CompletionStage that completes successfully if authorized or exceptionally if not.
